summary: Tyler Technologies filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing entry into a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan with a brokerage firm to repurchase up to $260.0 million of common stock. Repurchases may begin September 16, 2026, and end October 29, 2026. The plan sits under board authorizations of $1.0 billion (February 3, 2026) and an added $1.5 billion (July 24, 2026), leaving $1.416 billion available. No price per share, premium, or advisor is stated; funding comes from cash and credit facility borrowings. Watch execution pace and any acceleration signals.
